approval_source: Explicit reviewer confirmation in ChatGPT conversation

workspace_ownership.initial_owner: Authenticated user who creates the workspace
workspace_ownership.ownership_changes: Explicit, authorized, and auditable under applicable authorization policy

projects.workspace_relationship: Each project belongs to exactly one existing workspace

tasks.project_relationship: Each task belongs to exactly one project
tasks.workspace_scope: Must agree with the parent project's workspace
tasks.movement: Allowed only between projects in the same workspace, through an explicitly authorized operation
tasks.move_atomicity: All required changes succeed together or none do

verification_obligations: workspace creation assigns owner to authenticated creator
projects cannot change workspace through updates or transfer operations
same-workspace task moves succeed only when authorized and valid
invalid projects, workspaces, memberships, and assignees are rejected
failed moves and removals leave no partial mutations
member removal cannot leave unresolved ownership or assignment dependencies
applicable security-sensitive mutations produce unique audit identities

limitations: This record documents chat approval only.
It is not a cryptographic attestation or trusted evidence envelope.
Project/task deletion rules and detailed role-specific editable fields remain unresolved in their respective decision groups.
